decisions.reason: The instruction explicitly places the supplied picture at the bottom and does not change the distinct hero visual asset or its presentation.
Replacing the specific bottom image does not change the landing page's content mix, specification source, or screenshot-selection rule.
The source changes a particular bottom-of-page image asset, not the approved visual style, palette, or design reference.
The bottom image instruction does not alter any information collected by the early access form.
The image replacement has no effect on form-submission delivery triggers or recipients.
Placing a picture at the bottom does not enable animations or otherwise change the animation-free presentation constraint.
The source does not change the form-only contact-channel rule or restore standalone email or phone options.
The bottom image instruction does not change the early access button, its destination, or the destination form.
The source changes an image asset and does not modify the Founding Dealer headline or campaign copy.
The instruction concerns a bottom-of-page picture and does not alter the hero headline or supporting copy.
The bottom image replacement does not change the dealer-login button's placement or destination URL.
